# cpanel_calendar_delegate (Data Source)

Looks up access from one cPanel mail account to another account's default CalDAV calendar.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_calendar_delegate" "shared" {
  delegator = "calendar-owner@example.com"
  delegatee = "calendar-user@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `delegatee` (String) The mail account that receives access.
- `delegator` (String) The mail account that owns the calendar.

### Optional

- `calendar` (String) The cPanel calendar collection identifier. Only the default `calendar` collection is supported.

### Read-Only

- `calendar_name` (String) The `CPDAVD` display name for the delegated calendar. The value is empty when the legacy `CCS` API is used.
- `readonly` (Boolean) Whether the delegate may only read the calendar.
